app/global.css.name: Theme stylesheet
app/global.css.description: Builds the Fumadocs --color-fd-* theme on the --color-arbitrum-* palette tokens, remapped under .dark, plus the brand shadows.

app/layout.tsx.name: Root layout
app/layout.tsx.description: Mounts PostHog and the Fumadocs RootProvider, loads the self-hosted Aeonik fonts, and shows the announcement banner from content/vars.json.

app/not-found.tsx.name: Site 404 page
app/not-found.tsx.description: Renders the root 404 under HomeLayout with a search trigger and section cards, and mounts the not-found analytics tracker.
